description: Change when a scheduled print starts, or release it immediately. Pass schedule_for with a new absolute instant to move it; omit schedule_for (or send null) to start the print now. Only affects prints still waiting on a scheduled time - a print already staggered or downloading cannot be pushed back.

expected_job_uid.description: Job uid returned by list_scheduled_prints. The action is refused if that printer now holds a different pending print.

printer_id.description: Comma-separated printer id(s) whose scheduled print should move.

schedule_for.description: New absolute instant (ISO 8601), at least 1 minute and at most 7 days ahead. Omit or null to start the print now.

name: reschedule_print
